concerns.text: Tasks T102, T103, and T104 are present in the tasks document but have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. T102 (Ground Truth Verification) attempts to verify metadata not defined in the spec's Data Model. T103 (FLOP Estimation) and T104 (Physical Geometry Validation) implement scope-creep features (FLOP counting, geometric constant validation) explicitly absent from FR-001 through FR-008. These tasks represent unverified requirements that cannot be satisfied by the current specification.

Task T090 (Physical Interpretability Map) and T093 (Physical Constraint Validation) are tagged with [Review-All] or [Review-Pauling] but lack explicit FR/SC tags in the spec.md. While T093 extends T011c, the specific requirement to log 'physically suspect' geometries (bond lengths <0.7Å) is not defined in spec.md Edge Cases or FRs. These tasks rely on external research-stage reviews rather than the ratified spec, creating a traceability gap.

Task T006 (error_utils.py) is implemented but lacks a specific FR/SC tag. The spec.md Edge Cases define retry logic and logging schemas that are fully covered by T013a, T013b, and T013c. T006 appears to be a redundant utility module without a direct requirement anchor, potentially creating orphaned code.
